description: This file defines dependencies and configuration for a Telegram bot module within a larger plugin SDK-based project. It imports various functions and types from SDK modules, declares a type 'TelegramBotDeps' listing these dependencies, and provides a default implementation object 'defaultTelegramBotDeps' that lazily returns these dependencies.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the configuration settings for the bot from the runtime environment.

methods.name: resolveStorePath
methods.description: Resolves a filesystem path for storing configuration or session data.

methods.name: loadSessionStore
methods.description: Loads session data for the bot from persistent storage.

methods.name: upsertChannelPairingRequest
methods.description: Creates or updates pairing requests for communication channels.

methods.name: buildModelsProviderData
methods.description: Builds data models required for various bot functionalities.

methods.name: dispatchReplyWithBufferedBlockDispatcher
methods.description: Dispatches replies using buffered block dispatcher.

methods.name: listSkillCommandsForAgents
methods.description: Lists available skill commands for different agents.

methods.name: wasSentByBot
methods.description: Checks if a message was sent by the bot.

methods.name: resolveTelegramExecApproval
methods.description: Handles execution approval for Telegram-specific operations.

methods.name: createTelegramDraftStream
methods.description: Creates a stream for draft messages in Telegram.

methods.name: emitInternalMessageSentHook
methods.description: Emits an internal hook when a message is sent.

methods.name: createChannelReplyPipeline
methods.description: Creates a pipeline for channel reply handling.
